title: Summary
description: summary.json, written by ag generate alongside guidance.md and printed by ag summary. Counts, every unresolved record, and sidecar coverage; derived, never design authority. Written from summarize in src/artifacts.ts. guidance.md, the other half of the briefing, is Markdown and has no schema.

toolVersion.description: Toolkit version that wrote the file.

declarationDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical declarations and configuration, as in compilation-metadata.json.

limitation.description: Always states that declarations do not prove implementation conformance.

unresolved.description: Every unresolved node and relationship, sorted by ID.

sidecars.description: Schema and example coverage of contracts, data objects and artifacts.

withoutSchema.description: IDs without a schema. Behavioral contracts are expected here.
